findings.title: Deposit is 2 months' rent, above the 5-week cap
findings.detail: Assuming a covered private tenancy in England, annual rent is £10,200 and the five-week cap is £980.76 rounded down to pennies. The £1,700 deposit exceeds this amount. This check does not determine deposit protection. Source: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/tenant-fees-act-2019-guidance-for-tenants

findings.title: The contract requires an administration fee
findings.detail: The £150 signing charge needs removal or an explanation of an applicable permitted-payment category. Source: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/tenant-fees-act-2019-guidance-for-tenants

evidence.quote: The Tenant shall pay an administration fee of £150 on signing.
